# HR workflow sample recordings

<!-- Generated by apps/web-app/scripts/generate-hr-sample-recordings.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

41 example recordings of HR workflows across the employee lifecycle. Each file is a
session bundle in the same format the Ledgerium extension exports, so it can be uploaded
(Upload a recording, or `POST /api/upload`) and produces a workflow, SOP and process map.

How they are made: each workflow is a short script of browser actions. The script becomes raw
recorder events, which run through the real sensitivity classifier, normalizer and segmenter.
The steps are derived, not written by hand, and each one lists the events it came from.

What they are not: these are synthetic sessions, not captures of real people. Screen and field
names are representative of common HR tools (the app name comes from the domain, as in a real
recording), not copies of any vendor product. As in a real recording, typed values are never
captured, only that a field changed; on-screen labels are, so some steps click a link with a
person's name. Every name in these files is fictional. Social Security Number fields are flagged
and redacted by the policy rules, as during a real recording. One known gap: a field labelled
"Taxpayer ID" is not flagged, because the rule matches "tax-id" or "tax_id" but not "taxpayer"; its label
stays in the recording (never its value).

Regenerate with `pnpm --filter @ledgerium/web-app samples:hr`.

## Recruiting

| Workflow | Apps | Events | Steps | Redacted fields | Duration | File |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Open a Job Requisition | Workday | 25 | 4 | 0 | 1m 15s | [open-job-requisition.json](./open-job-requisition.json) |
| Post a Job to the Careers Page and LinkedIn | Greenhouse, Linkedin | 22 | 8 | 0 | 1m 49s | [post-job-to-boards.json](./post-job-to-boards.json) |
| Screen New Applicants | Greenhouse | 23 | 9 | 0 | 2m 12s | [screen-applicants.json](./screen-applicants.json) |
| Schedule an Onsite Interview Panel | Greenhouse, Calendar | 32 | 9 | 0 | 1m 36s | [schedule-interview-panel.json](./schedule-interview-panel.json) |
| Submit an Interview Scorecard | Gmail, Greenhouse | 21 | 4 | 0 | 1m 22s | [submit-interview-scorecard.json](./submit-interview-scorecard.json) |
| Create and Send an Offer Letter | Greenhouse, Docusign | 31 | 8 | 0 | 1m 47s | [extend-offer-letter.json](./extend-offer-letter.json) |

- **Open a Job Requisition**: A hiring manager creates a headcount requisition in the HRIS and routes it for budget approval.
- **Post a Job to the Careers Page and LinkedIn**: A recruiter builds the job post in the ATS, publishes it to the careers page, and confirms it went live on LinkedIn.
- **Screen New Applicants**: A recruiter reviews new applications one by one, rejects poor fits with a reason, and advances a candidate to the phone screen.
- **Schedule an Onsite Interview Panel**: A recruiting coordinator checks interviewer availability, books the panel, and sends the candidate their itinerary.
- **Submit an Interview Scorecard**: An interviewer rates the candidate against the job attributes, writes notes, and submits an overall recommendation.
- **Create and Send an Offer Letter**: A recruiter drafts the offer in the ATS, gets it approved, and sends the letter for e-signature.

- **Hire a New Employee in the HRIS**: An HR coordinator runs the Hire business process: position, start date, compensation and personal data.
- **Add a New Hire to Payroll**: Payroll adds the employee, sets pay rate, tax withholding and direct deposit before the first pay run.
- **Provision Accounts for a New Hire**: IT creates the identity, assigns the role-based app groups, and adds the new hire to Slack.
- **Request Equipment for a New Hire**: A hiring manager orders a laptop and peripherals through the service catalog with the start date.
- **Enroll a New Hire in Onboarding Training**: L&D enrolls the new hire in the onboarding learning plan with due dates and a manager notification.

- **Approve a Time Off Request**: A manager checks team coverage on the calendar, then approves a PTO request from their inbox.
- **Deny a Time Off Request**: The rejection path of the same task: a manager sends a PTO request back with a reason because coverage is short.

- **Review and Approve Team Timecards**: A manager reviews hourly timecards, fixes a missed punch, and approves the pay period.

## Offboarding

| Workflow | Apps | Events | Steps | Redacted fields | Duration | File |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Process an Employee Resignation | Gmail, Workday | 22 | 4 | 0 | 1m 07s | [process-resignation.json](./process-resignation.json) |
| Remove Access for a Departing Employee | Okta, Slack, ServiceNow | 26 | 7 | 0 | 1m 04s | [deprovision-departing-employee.json](./deprovision-departing-employee.json) |
| Run Final Pay and PTO Payout | Gusto | 21 | 4 | 0 | 0m 59s | [final-pay-and-pto-payout.json](./final-pay-and-pto-payout.json) |
| Send an Exit Survey and Record the Exit Interview | Cultureamp, ServiceNow | 18 | 5 | 0 | 1m 15s | [send-exit-survey.json](./send-exit-survey.json) |
| Rehire a Former Employee | Workday | 21 | 5 | 0 | 0m 53s | [rehire-former-employee.json](./rehire-former-employee.json) |

- **Process an Employee Resignation**: HR records a resignation: last day, reason, regrettable flag, and eligibility for rehire.
- **Remove Access for a Departing Employee**: IT deactivates the identity, transfers file ownership, removes the user from Slack, and logs device return.
- **Run Final Pay and PTO Payout**: Payroll dismisses the employee, pays out unused PTO, and checks the final paycheck date meets state rules.
- **Send an Exit Survey and Record the Exit Interview**: HR sends the exit survey and logs the themes from the exit conversation on the employee's case.
- **Rehire a Former Employee**: HR checks the former employee's rehire eligibility and reuses their record for a new hire.
